data.name: Hareesh
data.gender_notes: Hareesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hareesh is a Sanskrit name derived from Hari, the name of Lord Vishnu. It is a revered name in Hinduism and signifies the presence and protection of Lord Hari. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer divine blessings, wisdom, and strength. The name Hareesh carries the meaning “Lord Hari” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hareesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord hari and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hareesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Hari.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hareesh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hareesh holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism. It is derived from Hari, one of the most popular names of Lord Vishnu, who is also known as "Hare Rama, Hare Krishna". The name signifies the devotion and spiritual connection of the individual to Lord Vishnu, a deity revered for sustaining the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Hareesh holds immense significance as it is considered a divine name. It is believed that uttering the name Hareesh or hearing it from someone invokes the presence of Lord Hari, who is believed to protect, guide, and bestow blessings. The name is a reminder of the divine force that exists within us and around us, and serves as an inspiration to live a life filled with love, wisdom, and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hareesh: Radiance of Hari (Vishnu). Embodiment of love and devotion towards the divine.
